requirements_locked: Standalone additive architecture; do not replace or patch vanilla/third-party mob code for gang support.
No broad spawn-table takeover; natural gang encounters are ultra-rare and independently scheduled.
Craftable vanilla-ingredient Boombox is the reliable event entry point.
Street Gear activation covers skates, skateboards, BMX, scooters, hoverboards and future trick gear on the same original entity.
Removing Street Gear restores source-owned behavior/state.
Optional-mod adapters fail closed and never become hard dependencies.
Zero known JetSetCraft-caused compatibility regressions is a release gate; unknown unsupported cases degrade gracefully.
Dormant worlds/mobs incur negligible JetSetCraft overhead.
